entries.purpose: Historical-fire catalogue and final-perimeter context (not used for metrics or training)
Observed post-fire severity context for historical replays (not a training target or input)
entries.format: Zipped GeoTIFF + FGDC XML (6 files, 31.5 MB)
entries.preprocessing: Clipped to the study region, nearest-neighbour onto the LANDFIRE-aligned 30 m EPSG:5070 grid (exact pixel copy); processed years [2020, 2021, 2022, 2023, 2024] → data/processed/rasters/mtbs_severity/
entries.notes: Classes (from XML): 0=Background/No Data, 1=Unburned/Underburned to Low Burn Severity, 2=Low burn severity, 3=Moderate burn severity, 4=High Burn Severity, 5=Increased Greenness/Increased Vegetation Response, 6=Non-Processing Area Mask. MTBS 2025 does not intersect the WildfireTwin model domain.
